title: Memory Tensor RT Core Action and Tensor Displacement Semantics
purpose: Refine Memory Tensor RT by distinguishing core-domain symmetry-breaking action from tensor-domain displacement representation, preserving both without collapsing one into the other.

core_insight.statement: At the core RT domain, δα(A|<S>) is symmetry-breaking action. In the tensor domain, that action is represented as displacement. Displacement is therefore not ignored or demoted; it is the adjacent-domain representation of the core action.
core_insight.short_form: Core action projects into tensor mechanics as displacement.

core_domain.meaning: A symmetry condition breaking into distinguishable orientation.

tensor_domain.meaning: The tensor-domain representation of the core symmetry-breaking action.

observable_domain.meaning: The stabilized result available to observation after local resolution.

axiom_alignment.AX-RT-002: The tensor array is composed of tensor-domain displacement representations of core-domain symmetry-breaking actions, not discrete stored memory objects.
axiom_alignment.AX-RT-003: Memory recall is generated through traversal of displacement representations corresponding to prior and present symmetry-breaking actions, rather than retrieval of fixed records.
axiom_alignment.AX-RT-010: Core-domain symmetry-breaking action projects into adjacent tensor mechanics as displacement. The displacement representation preserves the action trace without replacing the core action.
axiom_alignment.AX-RT-011: Each domain may express the same underlying RT process through its own dominant primitive. Core RT uses action, tensor mechanics uses displacement, and observation uses identity.

orient.clarification: Orientation is derived from coupling and may select displacement traces that represent prior symmetry-breaking actions.

resolve.clarification: Resolution operates over displacement traces and produces observable identity outputs such as memory and confidence.

compare.clarification: Comparison operates on conditioned displacement traces or their resolved recall outputs, while RT remains the whole expression.

domain_translation.translation_rule: A core symmetry-breaking action is represented in tensor mechanics as a displacement trace.
domain_translation.rule_meaning: A core symmetry-breaking action is represented in tensor mechanics as a displacement trace.
domain_translation.inverse_warning: ΔA may imply a core action trace, but the tensor displacement alone does not exhaust the full RT action context.

forbidden_collapses: Do not reduce δα(A|<S>) to mere geometric displacement.
Do not ignore displacement as mathematically irrelevant.
Do not treat displacement as an already-settled object independent of action trace.
Do not treat observable identity as prior to symmetry-breaking action.
approved_claims: Displacement exists and is important in the tensor domain.
Core RT expresses the same process as symmetry-breaking action.
Tensor mechanics represents that action as displacement.
Observable identity is a stabilized downstream result.
